title: 第5章 帮小老虎做疏导真是太哇塞了-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    哎。

    秦夙摇摇头，把无意义的伤感都驱散掉。

    再着急的一把抓住谢尘无的手，“尘尘老师！我太想进步了！你快点告诉我，我要怎么才能突破？”

    尘尘？

    谢尘无低眸看看秦夙握住她的动作。

    她攥的很紧，可他只觉得是普通力道，这么弱的向导，还真想突破到S级吗？

    不过，有梦想总是好的。

    只是不知道这样柔弱无骨的手指，为他做起疏导来，会是什么样的感觉。

    “那，就跳过平淡的理论课，进入实操阶段。”谢尘无翻转大手，反握住秦夙，“下午教你怎么为我做疏导。”

    “是向导变强必须学习的东西？”

    “嗯。”

    “但……但是疏导的话？”秦夙又想起了诺亚，有点怂，“是不是必须跟你……亲密接触啊？”

    毕竟诺亚在宿舍楼堵她的时候，就是一副要对她做点什么的样子，她很难不往那方面脑补。

    谢尘无微微挑了下眉。

    熟练的向导完全可以仅通过精神层面来操作，可秦夙还是新手。

    他嘴角勾起个温和的笑意，“是的。”

    饭后，谢尘无带秦夙去疏导中心，借了一间白噪音室。

    进去后他就把房门反锁了，还按照自己喜好，将背景音调整成微风吹拂竹林。

    “刷——”

    “哈，虽然只闻其声。”秦夙被封闭小房间内的独处模式弄得十分拘谨，开始胡扯，“但这竹林挺密的哈。”

    谢尘无从容一笑，坐去了白色的治疗椅上。

    “你刚成为向导，应该很难操作精神体，和我接触是最简单的疏导方式。”他语气淡的像是事不关己，“如果我看着你，会让你不舒服，操作台上有眼罩和耳塞，你可以剥夺我的视觉和听觉。”

    秦夙听的一头冷汗。

    这疏导一开始就玩这么大？感官剥夺，在地球来说算是虐待了吧？

    “疏导是要以向导为核心展开的治疗方式，保证向导心理舒适才是第一位的。”他又说。

    “但……”秦夙实在是无从下手。

    见谢尘无转眸看过来，紧张的手心都出汗了。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)



Qin Su shook his head, dispelling all the meaningless sadness.

He grabbed Xie Chenwu’s hand anxiously, “Teacher Chenchen! I want to make progress so much! Please tell me quickly, how can I make a breakthrough?”

Dust?

Xie Chenwu lowered his eyes to see Qin Su holding her.

She clenched her tightly, but he only thought it was an ordinary strength. Does such a weak guide really want to break through to S level?

However, it’s always good to have dreams.

“I just don’t know what it would be like to use such weak and boneless fingers to guide him.

"Then, let's skip the boring theoretical class and enter the practical stage." Xie Chenwu turned his big hand over and held Qin Su in his hand, "I will teach you how to guide me this afternoon."

"Is it something that a guide must learn to become stronger?"

"Yeah."

"But...but what about counseling?" Qin Su thought of Noah again and was a little timid, "Do I have to have...intimate contact with you?"

After all, when Noah blocked her in the dormitory, he looked like he was going to do something to her. It was hard for her not to think about that.

Xie Chenwu raised his eyebrows slightly.

A skilled guide can completely operate through the mental level alone, but Qin Su is still a novice.

A gentle smile appeared on his lips, "Yes."

After dinner, Xie Chenwu took Qin Su to the counseling center and borrowed a white noise room.

After entering, he locked the door and adjusted the background sound to the breeze blowing in the bamboo forest according to his own preference.

"Brush——"

"Ha, although I only heard the sound." Qin Su was very cautious about being alone in the small closed room and started to talk nonsense, "But the bamboo forest is quite dense."

Xie Chen smiled calmly and sat on the white treatment chair.

"You have just become a guide. It should be difficult to operate your mental body. Contacting me is the easiest way to guide you." He said in a calm tone, as if it had nothing to do with him. "If I look at you, it will make you uncomfortable. There are eye masks and earplugs on the operating table. You can deprive me of my vision and hearing."

Qin Su broke into a cold sweat after hearing this.

Is this grooming so big from the beginning?Sensory deprivation is considered abuse on Earth, right?

“Counseling is a treatment method that takes the guide as the core, and ensuring the guide’s psychological comfort is the first priority.” He added.

"But..." Qin Su really didn't know what to do.

Seeing Xie Chen turn his eyes and look over, his nervous palms became sweaty.
